subject: Operations
title: Business Continuity Planning
description: Learn Business Continuity Planning in one minute.

hook.text: A fire destroys your only supplier's factory. Do you have a plan B? If not, you're weeks from shutdown.

buildup.text: Business continuity planning prepares companies to maintain operations during and after a major disruption.

discovery.text: BCPs identify critical functions, alternative suppliers, backup sites, and communication protocols for emergencies.

twist.text: Most BCPs sit in binders on shelves. The real test is whether teams practice the plan before disaster strikes.

climax.text: Samsung runs annual supply chain war games—simulating disruptions to test response speed and decision-making.

punchline.text: A plan you've never practiced is just a document.

quiz.question: What makes a business continuity plan effective?
